items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We had Sandy Williams, (Y.) Williams, (Y.) Jay C. Higginbotham, (Y.) Bobby Stark, (Y.) Coleman Hawkins - everybody in the band was (Y.)

ctx.x: Who were the fellows in the Fletcher Henderson band when you joined it?
Sandy Williams, Bobby Stark, Russell Procope, and Clarence Holiday, my best buddy.
